effect.multiplier: Multiplier: you gain {gain} once for each {per} card played this turn. The card producing the effect counts. Two cards producing the Multiplier effect stack.
effect.single-use: Single use (cannot be ignored): at the end of the turn in which the card was played, return it to the box.
effect.copy-played: Copy a played card: you copy the type and effects of a card played this turn. If applicable, the Single use effect applies to the copying card.
effect.copy-river: Copy a card from the River: you copy the type and effects of a card in the River. The restriction of a single Mercenary card type played per turn applies. If applicable, the Single use effect applies to the copying card.
effect.destroy: Destroy {value} card(s) from your hand: return them to the box.
effect.play-from-discard: Play a card from your discard pile: you may choose a card from your discard pile and play it. The restriction of a single Mercenary card type per turn applies.
effect.all-types: Play all the types you want: you may play as many Mercenary card types as you wish this turn.
effect.corrupt-from-hand: Corrupt a card from your hand: you may corrupt any card from your hand, without the usual cost of 3 resources.
effect.either: Use the effect before OR after the “/”:
help.card.mercenary: They give you effects and/or Revenue. On your turn, you may only play a single type of Mercenary cards.
help.card.equipment: They give you effects and/or Revenue. They can be played alone or with Mercenary cards of any type (Propaganda, Hacking, Corruption).
help.card.crossing-cost: Crossing cost on the Propaganda track: {value}
help.card.virus.title: Virus card
help.card.virus.desc: Each Corporation stacks its 5 Virus cards numbered 1 to 5 face up (5 on top, 1 at the bottom) next to the Central Port.
help.card.virus.neutralize: When the opponent moves the Virus pawn across the Central Port from this stack, the top card is removed and placed face down on top of this Corporation’s draw pile. Once card 1 has been neutralized this way, the opponent wins the game by Hacking.
help.card.virus.play: If a Virus card reaches your hand when you draw it, you may play it directly into your discard pile on your turn: it has no effect and no cost.
help.hand-bonus-token.title: Hand Bonus token
help.hand-bonus-token.desc: When your banner reaches the space of a Hand Bonus token, you gain it and place it next to your draw pile.
help.hand-bonus-token.effect: Increases your hand size by one card: each time you refill your hand, you refill it with one more card.
help.game-over.title: End of the game
help.game-over.corruption: {player} has corrupted 12 cards: victory by Corruption.
help.game-over.propaganda: {player}’s banner has crossed the 7 steps of their Propaganda track: victory by Propaganda.
help.game-over.hacking: {player} moved the Virus pawn across the Central Port from the opponent’s last Virus card: victory by Hacking.
help.game-over.reserve: The River cannot be refilled because the Reserve is empty. The Corporation that is ahead on at least two of the three victory conditions wins; otherwise it’s a tie.
help.game-over.reserve.winner: {player} is ahead on at least two victory conditions and wins the game.
help.game-over.reserve.tie: No Corporation is ahead on at least two victory conditions: it’s a tie.
help.game-over.progress.hacking: {count, plural, =0{No Virus card neutralized} one{# Virus card neutralized} other{# Virus cards neutralized}}
help.game-over.progress.hacking.pawn: (pawn {count, plural, one{# space} other{# spaces}} into the opponent’s card)
help.discard.title: {player}’s discard pile
help.discard.count: {count, plural, one{# card} other{# cards}}, from most recent to oldest.
help.central-port.title: Central Port
help.central-port.desc: In the middle of the Virus track, it separates the Virus cards of each Corporation.
help.central-port.advance: Moving the Virus pawn across the Central Port from the opponent’s Virus card flips that card, face down, onto its owner’s draw pile. If you flip your opponent’s last card this way, you win the game by Hacking.
help.central-port.retreat: Moving the Virus pawn back across the Central Port onto your own Virus card has no effect.
history.propaganda.advance: {player} advances their banner on the Propaganda track
hand-size.title: Handicap
hand-size.rule: We suggest adapting the game to the players’ skill levels. The less experienced player will draw and refill their hand to 7 cards (this can go up to 8 if needed), while their opponent will have a hand of 6 cards. Hand bonuses (see p.16) apply as usual.
tuto.corporations: Each player embodies a Corporation. There are 3 ways to win the game: through Corruption, Propaganda or Hacking.
tuto.hand: Your turn! You have 6 cards in hand: Mercenary cards ( Corruption, Propaganda or Hacking) and Equipment cards, in grey.
tuto.play-rule: On your turn, you must play at least one card. You can always play your Equipment cards, but you may only play a single type of Mercenary cards.
tuto.play-corruption: Play your 2 <corruption/> <yellow>Corruption</yellow> Mercenary cards and your <grey>Equipment</grey> card.
tuto.corrupt-symbols: For each group of 3 played, you may corrupt a card. Your Equipment card lets you choose between 3 symbols: choose to get your third Corruption symbol.
tuto.river: This is the River. Its 6 cards have several uses.
tuto.corruption-slots: Below each card of the River are 2 spaces of your Corruption area, each of which can hold 1 corrupted card.
tuto.corrupt-explain: Corrupting a card means taking a card from the River and placing it, face down, on one of the 6 spaces of your Corruption area. The River is then refilled with the top card of the Reserve.
tuto.corrupt-card: Corrupt this card: place it on the far left, below the first card of the River.
tuto.corruption-victory: The Corporation that corrupts 12 cards wins the game by Corruption!
tuto.buy-phase: After playing your cards and their effects, you may buy new cards.
tuto.revenue: Some cards have a Revenue. The total Revenue of the cards you played is your buying Revenue: this turn, it is 3.
tuto.cost: Your buying Revenue lets you buy one or more cards from the River. To buy a card, it must be at least equal to its Cost, shown here.
tuto.buy: Buy the card of your choice: it goes to your discard pile.
tuto.end-turn: At the end of your turn, your played cards go to your discard pile, then you draw to refill your hand to 6 cards.
tuto.opponent-turn: It is now your opponent’s turn.
tuto.virus-track: Each moves the Virus pawn one space along the Virus cards, towards those of the opposing Corporation.
tuto.virus-card: When the Virus pawn leaves your Virus card to reach the Central Port, that card is placed face down on top of your draw pile!
tuto.virus-card-deck: A Virus card has no effect: it will clutter your draw pile, then your hand.
tuto.hacking-victory: The Corporation that sends all 5 Virus cards of its opponent into their draw pile wins the game by Hacking!
tuto.play-propaganda: It’s your turn again. Play your 3 <propaganda/> <blue>Propaganda</blue> cards.
tuto.propaganda-track: Each played lets you advance your Corporation’s banner on the Propaganda track.
tuto.crossing-cost: To advance, you must pay the crossing cost shown on the card in front of your banner: here, 4 .
tuto.crossing-cost-modifiers: This cost decreases by 1 for each card you have corrupted at this space, but it increases by 1 for each card corrupted by your opponent at this space!
tuto.advance-banner: Thanks to the card you corrupted last turn, the cost here is only 3 : it is shown just below. Advance your banner.
tuto.hand-bonus: When your banner reaches one of your Hand Bonus tokens, you gain it: at the end of each turn, you will refill your hand with one more card.
tuto.propaganda-victory: And if your banner reaches the last space at the end of the Propaganda track, you immediately win the game by <propaganda/> <blue>Propaganda</blue>!
tuto.free-play: Now it’s up to you: buy the card of your choice, and good luck!
